positions.label: Balamb Garden
tips: Occult Fan I is on the library's rear rack. Start losing rare cards deliberately later — the Queen of Cards quest is long.
Garden becomes unreachable on Disc 4; almost everything in this pack closes at Lunatic Pandora.

positions.label: Fire Cavern
tips: Pick a generous timer; Ifrit is a story GF. Nothing closes here.

positions.label: Dollet Field Exam
tips: Draw Siren from Elvoret atop the comm tower — one fight, one chance (a much harder redraw waits in Ultimecia's castle).

positions.label: SeeD Inauguration
tips: The exam score sets your starting SeeD rank and salary. Weapons Monthly issues begin appearing from here.

positions.label: Timber
tips: Pet Pals Vol. 1 is on Rinoa's bed in the train — gone when the mission ends. Use Cid's Magical Lamp early for Diablos and Enc-None.
Lion Heart on Disc 1 is legal: Elnoyle cards → Energy Crystals → Pulse Ammo, T-Rexaur → Dragon Fang, Adamantoise → Adamantine.

positions.label: Galbadia Garden
tips: With the rental car, the Tomb of the Unknown King is open: note the student ID on the sword and collect the Brothers.

positions.label: Deling City
tips: Draw Carbuncle from the Iguions before rescuing Rinoa. Caraway holds the Rinoa card; Weapons Monthly 1st is in the sewers.

positions.label: D-District Prison
tips: Combat King 001 is in the prison; the rest of the set follows the story.

positions.label: Missile Base & Garden Uprising
tips: Draw Leviathan from NORG during the uprising. The missile base timer is generous — set it long.

positions.label: Fishermans Horizon
tips: The Garden is mobile: Centra Ruins (Odin, Tonberry King), Winhill, Shumi Village, the CC Group and the chocobo forests all open. The Master Fisherman is on FH's dock.

positions.label: Balamb Town Liberation
tips: Draw Pandemona from Fujin. Combat King 002 is in the hotel and only during the occupation.

positions.label: Trabia Garden
tips: Selphie's home Garden: a Timber Maniacs issue and the Weapons Monthly June issue are around the ruins.

positions.label: Battle of the Gardens
tips: Two GFs in one dungeon: Cerberus in the lobby (optional fight, easy to run past) and Alexander drawn from Edea.

positions.label: Edea's House
tips: Edea holds her own card from now on — win it before the world locks.

positions.label: White SeeD Ship
tips: One visit: sell Zone the Girl Next Door magazine and pick up the Timber Maniacs issue aboard.

positions.label: Esthar City
tips: Esthar opens the endgame: Solomon Ring at Tears Point (Doomtrain), the Ragnarok lands on the Deep Sea Research Center (Bahamut, Eden), Cactuar Island, the UFO chain, Occult Fan IV from the aide. Junk shops still work — remodel now.

positions.label: Lunar Base
tips: One visit: Combat King 005, a Timber Maniacs issue, and the Laguna card from Ellone.

positions.label: Lunatic Pandora
tips: The last beat with a world map. Everything marked LAST CHANCE closes when Time Compression starts. If you have Odin, Seifer's duel here turns him into Gilgamesh.

positions.label: Time Compression
tips: The world is locked to a few spots. Chocobo forests and the Deep Sea Research Center stay reachable by Ragnarok; towns and Garden do not.

positions.label: Ultimecia's Castle
tips: Every missed draw-only GF has a backup boss here. Omega Weapon: ring the bell with one party, sprint to the chapel with the other.

items.name: Siren

route.why: Draw from Elvoret during the exam — one fight, one chance

items.notes: Draw-only. If missed, re-drawable from Tri-Point in Ultimecia's Castle — a much harder fight.

items.name: Diablos (Magical Lamp)
items.location: Given by Cid when leaving for Timber

route.why: Use the lamp early — Diablos' Enc-None is the best QoL ability in the game

items.notes: The lamp keeps forever; save before using it.

items.name: Brothers

route.why: Sacred & Minotaur while you have the rental car

items.notes: Note the student ID number on the sword at the entrance. World locks on disc 4.

items.name: Carbuncle

route.why: Draw from the Iguions before rescuing Rinoa

items.notes: Draw-only. Re-drawable from Krysta in Ultimecia's Castle if missed.

items.name: Leviathan

route.why: Draw from NORG during the uprising

items.notes: Draw-only. Re-drawable from Trauma in Ultimecia's Castle if missed.

items.name: Pandemona

route.why: Draw from Fujin while liberating Balamb

items.notes: Draw-only. Re-drawable from Red Giant in Ultimecia's Castle if missed.

items.name: Combat King 002
items.location: Balamb hotel — during the occupation only

route.why: The hotel room is off limits once the town is free

items.notes: Check the hotel while Raijin and Fujin still run the town. Also counts as step two of the Combat King set.

items.name: Cerberus

route.why: Optional lobby fight during the battle — easy to run past

items.notes: Defeat it to receive the GF. Re-drawable from Gargantua in Ultimecia's Castle if missed.

items.name: Alexander

route.why: Draw from Edea in the disc-2 finale

items.notes: Draw-only. Re-drawable from Catoblepas in Ultimecia's Castle if missed.

items.name: Odin

route.why: 20-minute timed climb once the Garden is mobile

items.notes: Get him before disc 4 — a certain later duel turns him into something better.

items.name: Gilgamesh
items.notes: Owning Odin is the whole requirement: Seifer cuts him down mid-fight and Gilgamesh takes his place for the rest of the game.

items.name: Tonberry King
items.notes: Defeat ~20 Tonberries, then the King ambushes you. His shop abilities are superb.

items.name: Doomtrain (Solomon Ring)
steps: 6× Remedy+ (Alexander's Med LV Up on Remedies)
Use the ring from the item menu

route.why: Grab the Solomon Ring before the world locks

items.notes: The ring itself is the missable part; the ingredients can be farmed on Disc 4 if needed.

items.name: Bahamut

route.why: Ragnarok can land on the research center now

items.notes: Answer the blue light's questions (the third answer is the hidden one), then win the fight.

items.name: Eden
items.location: Deep Sea Research Center — excavation depths

route.why: Draw from Ultima Weapon at the bottom of the dig

items.notes: Manage the steam pressure puzzle on the way down. Also drawable from Tiamat in the castle.

items.name: Cactuar
items.notes: Fight the wandering green sprout — Jumbo Cactuar. Kamikaze and 1000 Needles await.

items.name: Occult Fan I

route.why: One bookshelf check before the exam

items.notes: In the library's rear rack. Garden is unreachable on disc 4.

items.name: Occult Fan II
items.notes: Buy it from the pub. Also involves the sad card-playing owner upstairs.

items.name: Occult Fan III
items.notes: Tied to the vase quest's conclusion — verify the exact handover in play.

items.name: Occult Fan IV

route.why: From the aide by the palace — one conversation

items.notes: From the aide near the presidential palace after the Esthar story opens up.

items.name: Timber Maniacs issues
items.notes: Timber, Dollet pub, Balamb hotel, FH, Trabia, Shumi, White SeeD ship and more — several rooms lock on disc 4. They feed Selphie's website and the Sir Laguna lore.

items.name: Pet Pals Vol. 1

route.why: Check Rinoa's bed on the train — gone when the mission ends

items.notes: Angelo's first trick magazine. The rest are purchasable later; this one is not.

items.name: Combat King 001–005
steps: 002 — Balamb hotel, only during the occupation
003 — Zell's admirer in the library, after his side story
items.notes: Zell's Duel finishers come from these. 001 and 002 are the one-shot windows; the rest follow the story.

items.name: Weapons Monthly issues
items.notes: Seven issues of remodel blueprints (1st, March–August). The March issue lists the ultimate weapons; junk shops only need the materials, so the magazines are for reading the recipes.

items.name: Queen of Cards questline
items.notes: Deliberately lose specific rare cards to move her around the world; her father then creates new rares (Kiros, Irvine, Chubby Chocobo, Doomtrain, Phoenix). Every lost card is winnable back.

items.name: CC Group card club
items.notes: Beat Jack through King inside the Garden before disc 4 — the club then joins the Ragnarok holding nearly every rare card.

items.name: Rare card sweep
items.notes: The 33 level 8–10 cards. Win the one-holder rares before the world locks: Seifer (Cid), Rinoa (General Caraway), Edea (herself, disc 3), Laguna (Ellone), Squall (Laguna). Most others migrate to the CC Group on disc 4.

items.name: Girl Next Door → Zone

route.why: Sell Zone his magazine aboard the ship — the visit doesn't repeat

items.notes: Pick the magazine up in Timber's Maniacs building first. Reward: Shiva card via Rename Card chain? Verify — sources differ; treat the delivery as the one-shot.

items.name: Lunar Base sweep

route.why: The base is evacuated behind you

items.notes: Combat King 005, the Timber Maniacs issue, and Ellone's Laguna card. Verify what else your version leaves in the lockers.

items.name: Winhill vase shards
items.notes: Reassemble the mayor's vase — four pieces around town; one involves the chicobo and one the flower field.

items.name: Obel Lake mystery
items.notes: Talk to the shadow in the lake, chase Mr. Monkey and the rock riddles across the continents. Ends in Three Stars and a Luck-J Scroll.

items.name: Shumi Village artisan quest
items.notes: The statue of Laguna, the Moomba, and the attendant's errands. Long, odd, worth it.

items.name: Master Fisherman
items.notes: The old man fishing off the dock — follow his story through FH's shops for his reward.

items.name: PuPu (UFO quest)
steps: Land at the Balamb crater and hand PuPu five Elixirs
items.notes: Do not attack it. The PuPu card is the reward.

items.name: Lion Heart (Squall)
steps: Adamantine ×1 (Adamantoise, or Card Mod a Minotaur card)

route.why: Remodel before disc 4 — no junk shops after the world locks
route.tradeoff: Famously doable on Disc 1 via Elnoyle cards — a long card-mod grind for the best weapon in the game two discs early

items.notes: Adamantine ×1, Dragon Fang ×4, Pulse Ammo ×12.

items.name: Everyone's final weapons
items.notes: Ehrgeiz, Exeter, Shooting Star, Strange Vision, Crescent Wish — remodel the party's best before junk shops become unreachable.

items.name: Chocobo forests & Chicobo
items.notes: Solve each forest with the ChocoZiner; the final forest yields Mog's Amulet and the Chicobo card. Forests stay reachable on disc 4.

items.name: Omega Weapon
items.notes: Ring the bell with one party, sprint to the chapel with the other. The true superboss.
